summary: Public Storage Operating Co (PSOC) filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for $900M in senior notes (4.700% due 2032, 5.150% due 2036) guaranteed by Public Storage. Proceeds will partly finance the pending acquisition of National Storage Affiliates Trust (NSA), expected to close in Q3 2026. If the NSA deal fails by Dec 16, 2026, PSOC must redeem notes at 101% plus accrued interest (special mandatory redemption). Notes are unsecured, unsubordinated, and structurally subordinated to subsidiary liabilities. No escrow or collateral is required. Risk-arb: watch for NSA deal completion and terms of the mandatory redemption trigger.
